def design(feats) -> Design:
    X = np.asarray(feats.x, float); y = np.asarray(feats.y, float); n, p = X.shape
    if not p or not n or np.unique(y).size < 2 or MAX_DRIVERS < 1: return Design(drivers=(), columns=(), products=(), loadings={})
    ids = list(feats.ids); labs = list(dict.fromkeys(feats.stratum))
    S = np.array([[s == l for l in labs[1:]] for s in feats.stratum], float).reshape(n, -1)
    base = np.column_stack([np.ones(n), S])
    def ll(Z, fitted=False):
        A = np.column_stack([base, Z]) if Z is not None else base
        b = np.zeros(A.shape[1])
        for _ in range(40):
            eta = np.clip(A @ b, -30, 30); m = 1 / (1 + np.exp(-eta)); w = m * (1 - m) + 1e-9
            H = A.T @ (A * w[:, None]) + 1e-6 * np.eye(A.shape[1])
            st = np.linalg.solve(H, A.T @ (y - m)); b += st * min(1., 5. / (np.max(np.abs(st)) + 1e-12))
            if np.max(np.abs(st)) < 1e-8: break
        m = np.clip(1 / (1 + np.exp(-np.clip(A @ b, -30, 30))), 1e-12, 1 - 1e-12)
        v = float(np.sum(y * np.log(m) + (1 - y) * np.log1p(-m)))
        return (v, m, A) if fitted else v
    def cols(sel, extra=()):
        z = [X[:, j] for j in sel] + [X[:, a] * X[:, b] for a, b in extra]
        return np.column_stack(z) if z else None
    C = X - X.mean(0); C /= np.maximum(np.linalg.norm(C, axis=0), 1e-12); R = C.T @ C
    sel = []; cur = ll(None)
    for k in range(MAX_DRIVERS):
        best = None
        for j in range(p):
            if j in sel or any(abs(R[j, s]) >= 0.6 for s in sel): continue
            v = ll(cols(sel + [j]))
            if best is None or v > best[0]: best = (v, j)
        if best is None or stats.chi2.sf(max(0., 2 * (best[0] - cur)), 1) > 0.1 / p: break
        v, j = best
        clus = [c for c in range(p) if abs(R[j, c]) >= 0.6 and c not in sel and not any(abs(R[c, s]) >= 0.6 for s in sel)]
        if len(clus) > 1:
            lls = {c: ll(cols(sel + [c])) for c in clus}
            near = [c for c in clus if lls[c] >= v - 2]
            j = max(near, key=lambda c: sum(R[c, d] ** 2 for d in clus)); v = lls[j]
        sel.append(j); cur = v
    changed = True
    while changed and sel:
        changed = False
        for j in list(sel):
            rest = [s for s in sel if s != j]
            if stats.chi2.sf(max(0., 2 * (cur - ll(cols(rest)))), 1) > 0.05 / p:
                sel = rest; cur = ll(cols(sel)); changed = True; break
    pairs = [(a, b) for a in range(p) for b in range(a, p)]
    _, mu, A = ll(cols(sel), True); w = mu * (1 - mu)
    H = A.T @ (w[:, None] * A) + 1e-6 * np.eye(A.shape[1]); sc = []
    for start in range(0, len(pairs), 512):
        G = np.column_stack([X[:, a] * X[:, b] for a, b in pairs[start:start + 512]])
        C = A.T @ (w[:, None] * G)
        V = np.sum(w[:, None] * G * G, 0) - np.sum(C * np.linalg.solve(H, C), 0)
        sc.extend((G.T @ (y - mu)) ** 2 / np.maximum(V, 1e-10))
    cand = []
    for i in np.argsort(-np.asarray(sc))[:25]:
        a, b = pairs[i]
        mains = sorted(set(sel) | {a, b}); l0 = ll(cols(mains)); l1 = ll(cols(mains, [(a, b)]))
        pv = stats.chi2.sf(max(0., 2 * (l1 - l0)), 1)
        if pv < 0.01 / len(pairs): cand.append((pv, a, b))
    prods = []
    for pv, a, b in sorted(cand):
        if len(prods) >= 2 or len({a, b}) > MAX_DRIVERS or any({a, b} & set(q) for q in prods): continue
        mains = sorted(set(sel) | {c for q in prods + [(a, b)] for c in q})
        gain = max(0., 2 * (ll(cols(mains, prods + [(a, b)])) - ll(cols(mains, prods))))
        if stats.chi2.sf(gain, 1) < 0.01 / len(pairs): prods.append((a, b))
    msel = list(dict.fromkeys(sel + [c for q in prods for c in q]))
    if prods:
        for c in list(msel):
            rest = [s for s in msel if s != c]
            if stats.chi2.sf(max(0., 2 * (ll(cols(msel, prods)) - ll(cols(rest, prods)))), 1) > 0.01 / p: msel = rest
    drivers = list(dict.fromkeys(msel + [c for q in prods for c in q]))
    drivers.sort(key=lambda j: ll(cols([c for c in msel if c != j], [q for q in prods if j not in q])))
    drivers = drivers[:MAX_DRIVERS]
    msel = [j for j in msel if j in drivers]; prods = [q for q in prods if all(j in drivers for j in q)]
    return Design(drivers=tuple(ids[j] for j in drivers), columns=tuple(ids[j] for j in msel),
                  products=tuple((ids[a], ids[b]) for a, b in prods), loadings={})
